gambits.name: Advance
gambits.desc: Pieces, pawns and pawnlings in that lane push; +10% move speed for 20 s.

gambits.name: Hold the File
gambits.desc: Pieces in that lane defend; +15% armor and resist for 20 s.

gambits.name: Regroup
gambits.desc: Every living piece gathers at the point for 15 s.

gambits.name: Pawn Storm
gambits.desc: That lane's pawns and pawnlings deal +50% damage and move 50% faster for 15 s.

gambits.name: Check
gambits.desc: Marks an enemy piece: it takes 20% more damage for 8 s, visible to all.

gambits.name: Castle
gambits.desc: King and Rook swap places instantly.

gambits.name: Queen's Gambit
gambits.desc: Queen deals +40% damage for 12 s, then -20% for 6 s.

gambits.name: Siege
gambits.desc: Rook and its lane focus a Bastion or Throne; +30% structure damage for 10 s.

gambits.name: Sanctuary
gambits.desc: A zone that heals allies 4% max health per second for 6 s.

gambits.name: Fork
gambits.desc: Knight leaps to an enemy piece within reach and stuns it for 1 s.
